integrity: The formulas are proved within stated graph and labeling conventions, and executable finite tests accompany them. Self-review only; no external audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two-factor rectangular rook graphs with both factor orders at least two. Originality relative to unindexed bipartite star-forest enumeration is not fully settled. Finite computations support but cannot replace proof.
title: General-position and maximal-set polynomials of rectangular rook graphs
